Subject head is the nominal 'playing' (gerundial noun in 'Garcia's trumpet playing'); copular 'be' requires an adjectival/nominal subject complement, not a manner adverb. Must be 'was flawless'. Rescue parses fail: 'playing' cannot be re-analyzed as a progressive verb because it precedes 'was' as subject head, and no ellipsis or inversion licenses a bare adverb as copular complement. Ungrammatical.
